text: {"overall_winner": "A", "qualities": [{"evidence": "organizing the text into distinct body paragraphs introduced by functional transition phrases like \"The first reason\", \"The second and probably most important reason\", and \"Although the strongest reason\"", "quality": "structural organization", "description": "Captures the logical division and sequential flow of arguments across paragraphs."}, {"evidence": "citing evidence, expanding on mental health impacts, and offering a counterargument with a practical solution", "quality": "argumentative elaboration", "description": "Reflects the depth and completeness with which supporting ideas are developed."}, {"evidence": "maintaining correct subject-verb agreement and complex sentence structures despite minor typos", "quality": "grammatical accuracy", "description": "Measures adherence to standard English syntax and morphological rules."}, {"evidence": "proper spacing between words and standard usage of apostrophes in contractions like \"don't\" compared to errors like \"should'n\"", "quality": "mechanics and orthography", "description": "Reflects adherence to standard conventions of punctuation, spacing, and spelling."}]}
